name: Aurelith
summary: The cradle of the mortal realms. One great landmass of varied climes, split by the scar of the Quiet, ringed by cold seas and one burning desert.

regions.name: The Crownlands
regions.summary: The fertile heart of Aurelith, seat of the old kingdoms and the capital Velkash. Breadbasket, crossroads, and center of the current political order.

regions.name: The Ashlands
regions.summary: Where the Sundering struck hardest. A grey scrubland of dead magic and leaning ruins, dotted with villages that pay the Quiet in prayer and silence.

regions.name: The Dusk Reach
regions.summary: Northern highlands of long winters and old stone. Home to the deep-kingdoms and the last stands of greenwood.

regions.name: The Burning Sands
regions.summary: A southern desert of glass-dunes and buried cities, crossed by silent-tongue caravans. The Glimmer here flickers like heat-haze.

neighbors.name: The Veiled Sea
neighbors.note: Uncharted; ships that sail past the horizon are said to find the Veil.

neighbors.name: The Bone Archipelago
neighbors.note: Skeleton coasts; home to pirates and forgotten shrines.

geography_notes: The Quiet runs north-east to south-west, a visible scar of cracked earth and silver mist.
The King's Road avoids the Quiet at all costs; Ashveil Cross is its single sanctioned crossing.
